subject: EIM status: suites reproduced, TF1-era code is the risk
body:
Hi Santiago, Dmitri,

Reproduction is done. The small_problems suite matches the release across targets - checkerboard with the HIS algorithm converges cleanly, and the MNIST runs (static_mnist, rejection_sampling proposal over a bernoulli_vae model) land within 0.3 nats of the published log-likelihood lower bounds. Ondrej also verified the variational-bound framing: our LAI and rejection-sampling variants line up as expected under the unified EIM view, which makes the API design much cleaner.

The risk: this is TF1-era TensorFlow through and through - estimator-style loops, sessions in places. Wrapping it as a supported library without a compat layer means every consumer inherits that. Ondrej and I estimate ~3 weeks to port the core samplers to TF2 eager, which does not fit before the Mar 20 API freeze.

Options: freeze the API over the compat shim now and port underneath in Q2, or slip the freeze two weeks. We lean shim-first. Call?

Fumiko
